title: Hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='balloon' x1='0' y1='0' x2='0' y2='1'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5a5a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d92b2b'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- envelope panel left -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='30' fill='#ffcc33'/>
  <!-- main balloon body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='20' ry='30' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <!-- bright stripe highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='32' rx='6' ry='12' fill='#ff9a9a' opacity='0.75'/>
  <!-- bottom skirt of balloon -->
  <path d='M32 60 Q50 70 68 60 Q64 52 50 52 Q36 52 32 60 Z' fill='#e04a2b'/>
  <!-- ropes -->
  <line x1='38' y1='62' x2='43' y2='76' stroke='#f2d16b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='62' y1='62' x2='57' y2='76' stroke='#f2d16b' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- basket -->
  <rect x='41' y='76' width='18' height='13' rx='2' fill='#c78a3c'/>
  <rect x='41' y='79' width='18' height='2' fill='#a86c28'/>
  <rect x='41' y='84' width='18' height='2' fill='#a86c28'/>
  <!-- basket rim -->
  <rect x='39' y='74' width='22' height='4' rx='2' fill='#e0a94f'/>
  <!-- tiny flame glow above basket -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='71' r='3' fill='#ffe066'/>
</svg>
